# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC31 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

## Scope

RC31 adds a keyboard Git changed-file picker so status output becomes actionable without leaving the streamlined iPad/Blink IDE surface.

- `Esc v o` opens a `GIT CHANGES` picker.
- `:changes`, `:git-changes`, `:changed-files`, and `:open-change` open the same picker.
- The picker snapshots one bounded `git status --porcelain=v2` read and filters the retained labels locally as the user types.
- Labels show index/worktree glyphs, repository-relative path, and rename source when Git reports one.
- Enter opens the selected changed path through the normal file-open route, with jump-history and recent-file tracking.
- A clean worktree reports `Working tree clean` without opening an empty prompt.
- The command does not stage, save, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the changed-file picker route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
